name: OP_0
description: Pushes an empty byte string, which the VM reads as the number 0 and as false.
cost: Base instruction cost 100; pushes 0 bytes.

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_PUSHBYTES_N
description: Bytes 0x01 through 0x4b (1–75) are not named instructions: each pushes the next N bytes of the script to the stack, where N is the opcode value. For example, 0x14 pushes the next 20 bytes. Under the minimal-push rule, data of 1–75 bytes must use this form unless a shorter push (such as OP_1–OP_16) exists.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus N bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_PUSHDATA1
description: The next byte gives a length (0–255); that many following bytes are pushed. Minimal-push rules allow it only for 76–255 bytes.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed. Since 2025, pushes may be up to 10,000 bytes (was 520).

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_PUSHDATA2
description: The next two bytes (little-endian) give a length; that many following bytes are pushed. Needed for pushes over 255 bytes.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed. Since 2025 the stack item limit is 10,000 bytes (was 520).
btcNote: BTC keeps the 520-byte stack item limit.

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_PUSHDATA4
description: The next four bytes (little-endian) give a length; that many following bytes are pushed. The 10,000-byte stack item limit makes it redundant in practice, and minimal-push rules reject it for any size OP_PUSHDATA2 can encode.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed.

name: OP_1NEGATE

name: OP_RESERVED
description: Makes the script fail if executed. Inside an unexecuted OP_IF branch it is ignored.
btcNote: In Tapscript (BIP-342) this byte is an OP_SUCCESSx code reserved for future soft forks.

name: OP_1

name: OP_2

name: OP_NOP
description: Does nothing.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_VER
description: Originally pushed the client version; long reserved. Makes the script fail if executed, and is ignored in an unexecuted branch.
btcNote: In Tapscript (BIP-342) this byte is an OP_SUCCESSx code reserved for future soft forks.

name: OP_IF
description: Pops the top item; if it is true, runs the statements that follow up to OP_ELSE or OP_ENDIF. The condition must be minimally encoded (empty or 0x01).
cost: Base instruction cost 100. Control stack depth is limited to 100 (2025 VM limits).

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_NOTIF
description: Pops the top item; if it is false, runs the statements that follow up to OP_ELSE or OP_ENDIF.
cost: Base instruction cost 100. Control stack depth is limited to 100 (2025 VM limits).

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_BEGIN
description: Marks the start of a loop by pushing the current instruction position to the control stack. The matching OP_UNTIL jumps back here. This byte was the disabled OP_VERIF before May 2026.
cost: Base instruction cost 100. Loops are bounded by the density-based operation cost and hashing limits, not by an iteration count.
example: OP_0 OP_BEGIN OP_1ADD OP_DUP OP_10 OP_EQUAL OP_UNTIL
btcNote: BTC has no loops. 0x65 is OP_VERIF there, which fails even in an unexecuted branch.

name: OP_UNTIL
description: Closes a loop. It pops the top stack item: if false (0), execution jumps back to just after the matching OP_BEGIN; if true, execution continues. This byte was the disabled OP_VERNOTIF before May 2026.
cost: Base instruction cost 100. Every repeated instruction pays its cost again, so the operation cost limit bounds total loop work.
example: OP_0 OP_BEGIN OP_1ADD OP_DUP OP_10 OP_EQUAL OP_UNTIL
btcNote: BTC has no loops. 0x66 is OP_VERNOTIF there, which fails even in an unexecuted branch.

name: OP_ELSE
description: Switches to the other branch of the current OP_IF or OP_NOTIF block.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_ENDIF
description: Ends an OP_IF / OP_NOTIF block. Every conditional block must be closed, or the script fails.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_VERIFY
description: Pops the top item and fails the script unless it is true.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_RETURN
description: Fails the script immediately. Outputs that start with OP_RETURN are provably unspendable and are used to carry data.

name: OP_TOALTSTACK
description: Moves the top item to the alternate stack.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_FROMALTSTACK
description: Moves the top item of the alternate stack to the main stack.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_2DROP
description: Removes the top two items.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_2DUP
description: Duplicates the top two items.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_3DUP
stackOut: a b c a b c
description: Duplicates the top three items.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_2OVER
stackOut: a b c d a b
description: Copies the pair of items two pairs back to the top.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_2ROT
stackIn: a b c d e f
stackOut: c d e f a b
description: Moves the fifth and sixth items to the top.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).
example: OP_1 OP_2 OP_3 OP_4 OP_5 OP_6 OP_2ROT

name: OP_2SWAP
description: Swaps the top two pairs of items.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_IFDUP
description: Duplicates the top item if it is not zero.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_DEPTH
description: Pushes the number of items on the stack.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_DROP
description: Removes the top item.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_DUP
description: Duplicates the top item. Most famous as the first step of a P2PKH lock.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_NIP
description: Removes the second-from-top item.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_OVER
description: Copies the second-from-top item to the top.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_PICK
description: Pops n, then copies the item n places back to the top.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_ROLL
description: Pops n, then moves the item n places back to the top.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed plus the roll depth, e.g. <'a'> <'b'> <'c'> <2> OP_ROLL costs 103 (2025 VM limits).

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_ROT
description: Moves the third item to the top.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_SWAP
description: Swaps the top two items.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_TUCK
description: Copies the top item below the second item.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus bytes pushed (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_CAT
description: Concatenates the top two items. Disabled in Bitcoin since 2010 and re-enabled on BCH in May 2018. Covenants use it to build output scripts on the stack.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus result length. The result may be up to 10,000 bytes since 2025 (was 520).
btcNote: Disabled in BTC since 2010. BIP-347 proposes re-adding it in Tapscript via OP_SUCCESS126 (same byte, 0x7e); not activated.

sources.title: BCHN upgrade specs: Restore disabled script opcodes, May 2018

name: OP_SPLIT
description: Splits a byte string at position n into two items. It took over the byte of the disabled OP_SUBSTR and replaces OP_SUBSTR, OP_LEFT and OP_RIGHT.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus the bytes of both pushed parts (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: 0x7f is the disabled OP_SUBSTR in BTC; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

sources.title: BCHN upgrade specs: Restore disabled script opcodes, May 2018

name: OP_NUM2BIN
description: Converts number n to a byte string of exactly `size` bytes, padding with zeros and keeping the sign bit. It uses the byte of the disabled OP_LEFT.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus result length (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: 0x80 is the disabled OP_LEFT in BTC; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

sources.title: BCHN upgrade specs: Restore disabled script opcodes, May 2018

name: OP_BIN2NUM
description: Converts a byte string to the minimally encoded number it represents. It uses the byte of the disabled OP_RIGHT.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus result length (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: 0x81 is the disabled OP_RIGHT in BTC; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

sources.title: BCHN upgrade specs: Restore disabled script opcodes, May 2018

name: OP_SIZE
description: Pushes the byte length of the top item without removing it.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus the byte length of the pushed result (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_INVERT
description: Flips every bit of the top item (bitwise NOT). Disabled since 2010 and re-enabled on BCH in May 2026.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus the byte length of the pushed result (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: Disabled since 2010; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

name: OP_AND
description: Bitwise AND of two byte strings of equal length. Disabled in Bitcoin since 2010 and re-enabled on BCH in May 2018.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus result length, counted as a push even if done in place (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: Disabled since 2010; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

name: OP_EQUAL
description: Pushes 1 if the two top items are byte-for-byte equal, otherwise 0.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus the byte length of the pushed result (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_EQUALVERIFY
description: OP_EQUAL followed by OP_VERIFY: fails unless the two top items are equal.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_DEFINE
description: Stores a function body (bytecode) in the function table under an identifier of 0–7 bytes. Functions are immutable: redefining an identifier fails. This byte was OP_RESERVED1 before May 2026.
cost: Base instruction cost 100. Defined functions share the 1,000 memory-slot limit with stack and altstack items.
example: <OP_DUP OP_MUL> OP_0 OP_DEFINE OP_3 OP_0 OP_INVOKE OP_9 OP_EQUAL
btcNote: 0x89 is OP_RESERVED1 in BTC; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

sources.title: CHIP-2025-05 Functions: Function Definition and Invocation Operations

name: OP_INVOKE
description: Pops a function identifier and runs that function's bytecode on the current stack, then continues after OP_INVOKE. Fails if no function has that identifier. This byte was OP_RESERVED2 before May 2026.
cost: Base instruction cost 100, plus the cost of every instruction the function runs. Each call uses a control-stack frame (depth limit 100).
example: <OP_DUP OP_MUL> OP_0 OP_DEFINE OP_3 OP_0 OP_INVOKE OP_9 OP_EQUAL
btcNote: 0x8a is OP_RESERVED2 in BTC; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

sources.title: CHIP-2025-05 Functions: Function Definition and Invocation Operations

name: OP_1ADD
description: Adds 1 to the top number. Since May 2025 numbers may be up to 10,000 bytes long (BigInt).
cost: Base instruction cost 100, plus the result length, plus the result length again to cover number encoding (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: BTC limits arithmetic inputs to 4 bytes.

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_1SUB

name: OP_LSHIFTNUM
description: Arithmetic left shift: multiplies number a by 2 to the power `bits`. Negative shift counts fail. This byte was the disabled OP_2MUL before May 2026.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus the byte length of the pushed result (2025 VM limits). Fails if the result exceeds 10,000 bytes.
btcNote: 0x8d is the disabled OP_2MUL in BTC; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

name: OP_RSHIFTNUM
description: Arithmetic right shift: divides number a by 2 to the power `bits`, rounding toward negative infinity. Negative shift counts fail. This byte was the disabled OP_2DIV before May 2026.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus the byte length of the pushed result (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: 0x8e is the disabled OP_2DIV in BTC; an OP_SUCCESS code in Tapscript.

cost: Base instruction cost 100, plus the result length, plus the result length again to cover number encoding (2025 VM limits).

name: OP_MUL

name: OP_CODESEPARATOR

name: OP_CHECKSIG
description: Checks a transaction signature against a public key and pushes 1 or 0. Since May 2019 it accepts both ECDSA and Schnorr signatures,, told apart by signature length.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus 26,000 per signature check, plus hashing cost for the signing serialization (2025 VM limits). Also counted by the 2020 SigChecks limit.
btcNote: BTC uses ECDSA in legacy/SegWit v0 scripts and BIP-340 Schnorr only in Tapscript; the signing serialization also differs (BCH uses SIGHASH_FORKID).

name: OP_CHECKSIGVERIFY
description: OP_CHECKSIG followed by OP_VERIFY: fails unless the signature is valid.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus 26,000 per signature check, plus hashing cost for the signing serialization (2025 VM limits). Also counted by the 2020 SigChecks limit.
btcNote: Same opcode, but BTC's signature types and signing serialization differ.

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_CHECKMULTISIG
description: Checks m-of-n signatures and pushes 1 or 0. Since November 2019 it accepts Schnorr signatures when the dummy item is a bitfield that names which keys signed; ECDSA mode requires a null dummy.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus 26,000 per signature check, plus hashing cost for the signing serialization (2025 VM limits). Also counted by the 2020 SigChecks limit. Before 2025 it also added n to the 201-operation count; that limit is gone.
btcNote: BTC has no Schnorr multisig mode and disables OP_CHECKMULTISIG in Tapscript in favor of OP_CHECKSIGADD (BIP-342).

sources.title: CHIP-2021-05 VM Limits: Targeted Virtual Machine Limits

name: OP_CHECKMULTISIGVERIFY
description: OP_CHECKMULTISIG followed by OP_VERIFY.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus 26,000 per signature check, plus hashing cost for the signing serialization (2025 VM limits). Also counted by the 2020 SigChecks limit.
btcNote: Disabled in BTC Tapscript (BIP-342); no Schnorr mode.

name: OP_NOP1
description: Does nothing; reserved for future upgrades. Standard relay policy rejects scripts that use it.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY
description: Fails unless the transaction's locktime is at least t (block height or time, same kind) and the input is not final. Leaves t on the stack. Inherited from Bitcoin's BIP-65.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY
description: Fails unless the input's relative locktime (sequence number) is at least n. Leaves n on the stack. Inherited from Bitcoin's BIP-112.
cost: Base instruction cost 100.

name: OP_CHECKDATASIG
description: Checks a signature over arbitrary message data (SHA-256 of msg), not the transaction. It lets contracts verify oracle-signed data. Accepts Schnorr signatures since May 2019.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus 26,000 per signature check, plus hashing cost for the message (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: BTC has no data-signature opcode. In Tapscript, 0xba is OP_CHECKSIGADD (BIP-342), a different operation.

name: OP_CHECKDATASIGVERIFY
description: OP_CHECKDATASIG followed by OP_VERIFY.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus 26,000 per signature check, plus hashing cost for the message (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: In Tapscript (BIP-342) this byte is an OP_SUCCESSx code reserved for future soft forks.

name: OP_REVERSEBYTES
description: Reverses the byte order of the top item. Useful for switching between little-endian and big-endian data, such as hashes shown in explorers.
cost: Base instruction cost 100 plus the byte length of the pushed result (2025 VM limits).
btcNote: In Tapscript (BIP-342) this byte is an OP_SUCCESSx code reserved for future soft forks.

name: OP_UNKNOWN212–255
description: Bytes 0xd4 through 0xff (212–255) are undefined. A script fails if it executes one, which keeps them free for future upgrades. Libauth names them OP_UNKNOWN212 to OP_UNKNOWN255.
btcNote: Also undefined in BTC; 0xd4–0xfe are OP_SUCCESS codes in Tapscript.
